text: Founded GES-NEWS, the monthly student newsletter of Hofstra's Department of Geology, Environment and Sustainability, co-edited with the department chair.
New Spring 2027 Honors seminar: Community-Engaged Earth Data and Sustainability, with Holy Cross High School.
Geostatistics course rebuilt around R and Python, in planning for next semester.
Intro to R for Geoscience and Sustainability launched, no coding experience required.
R for Earth and Sustainability Data Analytics is out in paperback, hardcover, and Kindle.
